page.overview:
What is Dial Boat?

A Dial Boat is a boat that uses Dials for propulsion, mainly through the use of Breath Dials. They can travel on the Milky Road quite efficiently. One notable example of a Dial Boat is the Karasumaru.

All the Dial Boats seen thus far have been relatively small s. They could be rented at the gondola port on Angel Island prior to its destruction. As a result of its weight, a Dial Boat is very slow compared to a Waver. The Karasumaru was able to push a much larger ship, the Going Merry, when it was sailing on the Milky Road through the usage of two Breath Dials.

In the anime, Conis explains slightly more about the Dials Boats, introducing a hotel boat where people can sleep and a speed-oriented boat with a giant Breath Dial.
